summary: On top of v0.8.183 / 688fab95, added a source-built native Windows RSS e-stop helper for tools/rss_estop_lib.ps1. It avoids the PowerShell/pwsh 100ms process-tree polling path and caches its generated helper outside target/ so cold perf cleanup does not charge sampler compilation to compiler time. Latest official perf gate: cold=3.74s, hot=0.31s, peak_mem=315MB.
